description: Look up a specific Polymarket market by id: details, live price, and an orderbook snapshot for ONE outcome token. Falls back to a direct Gamma lookup when the id is outside the precomputed cache's top markets by volume.

outcome.description: Which token to price - match this to the side you intend to trade (place_order/sell_order's BUY_YES/SELL_YES → 'Yes', BUY_NO/SELL_NO → 'No'). Defaults to 'Yes'. YES and NO books move somewhat independently, not simply 1 − each other, so quoting the wrong one hands you the wrong price.

name: get_market
title: Get a market's price and orderbook
